import os,glob,re
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])   # this instance's own log: the folder keeps every earlier one's
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}

        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))

    div=[r for r in range(H) if all(x==5 for x in g[r])][0]
    top=lambda r: r<div; bot=lambda r: r>div
    def shapes(g,color,region):
        cells=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if g[r][c]==color and region(r)]
        if not cells: return None
        rs=[r for r,c in cells]; cs=[c for r,c in cells]
        r0,c0=min(rs),min(cs)
        h=max(rs)-r0+1; w=max(cs)-c0+1
        pat=[[color if (r0+i,c0+j) in set(cells) else 0 for j in range(w)] for i in range(h)]
        return pat,r0,c0,color
    tops=[shapes(g,c,top) for c in range(1,10) if c!=5]
    tops=[t for t in tops if t]
    bots=[shapes(g,c,bot) for c in range(1,10) if c!=5]
    bots=[b for b in bots if b]
    bpat,br,bc,bcol=bots[0]
    tops.sort(key=lambda t:t[2])
    kept=[tops[-1],tops[0]] if len(tops)>=3 else tops  # rightmost, leftmost
    canvas=[[0]*W for _ in range(H-div-1)]
    def place(pat,r,c):
        for i,row in enumerate(pat):
            for j,v in enumerate(row):
                if v: canvas[r+i][c+j]=v
    place(bpat,br-div-1,bc)
    # non-bottom-duplicate kept shapes stack directly above bottom shape, rightmost first
    placed=[bpat]
    for t in kept:
        pat,r,c,col=t
        if pat==bpat: continue  # merges with bottom shape
        rr=br-div-1-len(bpat)*len(placed)  # stack above
        place(pat,rr,bc)
